answer: Staked review, capped: 8 reviews per identity per epoch, 250 POA each, rewards vest over 12 epochs. Spot checks hit 30 percent of grades and one upheld error burns the stake. A grove of 1,000 clones yields 8,000 reviews against 40,000 submissions, so it cannot grade itself into payout. Progress is a glacier pace by design. The velvet rope is the cap: 8, then done.
